integrity: The accompanying exact rational interval certificate bounds the theta derivative and curvature; finite-path numerical checks are independently corroborative rather than proof. The infinite-family limit is established by an explicit spectral and quadrature argument.

title: A universal diffusive boundary layer for finite-time leader placement on paths
